scope: Separate v1.0.1 hardware baseline and rear-gamma tuning tests; not installation acceptance of the v1.0.2 APK set

baseline_v1_0_1.runtime: Unmodified public v1.0.1 packages and recovery scripts
baseline_v1_0_1.issue_2: PASS: untouched PREPARED cancellation preserved the original state and backups; a new preparation and installation then succeeded

snapshot_endurance.scope: Normal GUI preview, local photos, switching, normal close and reopening; driver completion counters are not application display FPS

audio.scope: Audible speaker playback was checked before installation and during front-camera capture; microphone recording was not tested

sleep.postwake_capture: Front/rear switching, three local photos, reopening and clean STOP passed

baseline_v1_0_1.issue_1: PASS: an external configuration change was refused before restoration writes; only the test change was then removed and ordinary restoration succeeded
baseline_v1_0_1.restoration: PASS: after normal restoration, reboot and GUI login, recorded package/world, saved-target contents and attributes, boot partition and boot-mount conditions matched the original state
baseline_v1_0_1.restoration_limit: Recorded targets were verified; this is not a whole-filesystem byte comparison

rear_gamma_comparison.runtime: The same v1.0.1 ELF binaries for metadata and visual comparisons; front tuning was unchanged
rear_gamma_comparison.change: Rear Adjust gamma 2.2 to 2.4; AE, default rear contrast 1.0 and the 30 fps request remain unchanged
rear_gamma_comparison.fps_scope: Rate calculated from received cam buffer timestamps, not Snapshot display FPS; 15 fps was a diagnostic comparison, not the selected configuration
rear_gamma_comparison.sensor_timing: Rear binned-mode pixel rate 144 MHz and horizontal blanking 2188 were consistent, including after front/rear switching
rear_gamma_comparison.low_light_limit: Rear exposure and analogue gain reached their 30 fps limits in the tested scene; gamma changes midtones without removing those limits

visual_observations.result_ja: 中間調が明るくなり視認性が改善
比較ではgamma 2.4の視認性が高い
visual_observations.result_en: Gamma 2.4 had better visibility in the comparison

rear_gamma_comparison.visual_scope: Limited same-scene visual comparison using candidate YAML; no quantitative or full image-quality calibration
rear_gamma_comparison.final_state: Temporary tuning and application/session changes were removed; ordinary restoration, a new boot, GUI login and verification of the recorded original state passed
rear_gamma_comparison.metadata_method: cam standard Gamma controls selected 2.4 or 2.2 with the baseline tuning file. The seven-case metadata run did not load the candidate YAML override
rear_gamma_comparison.visual_method: A separate Snapshot comparison used the temporary rear-only candidate YAML override, with its exact SHA256 verified

v1_0_2_candidate_boundary.packaging_scope: Four libcamera APKs and two meta APKs are repackaged; the other five APKs are retained byte-identically
v1_0_2_candidate_boundary.elf_scope: No new ELF build is part of the tuning change; candidate packaging must verify reuse of the tested v1.0.1 ELF bytes
v1_0_2_candidate_boundary.candidate_package_verification: Package signatures, payload/source correspondence and bundle checks are recorded separately from these hardware results

source_change_host_checks.scope: Checks of the initial gamma source and documentation change, before candidate packaging; not a substitute for package or hardware verification

remaining_limits: Complete colour, noise, lighting/flicker and distance-dependent AF calibration
Day-scale endurance and other SKUs or kernels
Concurrent hardware codec, MDP or JPEG use with SCP
SoftISP output application of computed digital gain is a separate unimplemented change
New v1.0.2 APK installation and restoration
privacy: No camera pixels, private raw logs, credentials or unique device identifiers are included
